canonicalHierarchySource.policy: RadPrimer breadcrumbTrail is the canonical hierarchy/backbone.

sourceCoverage.statdxRadPrimerImageCoverageSummary: STATdx exactly duplicates all 4 RadPrimer images by stable source image ID and visual inspection of actual image_evidence files, and adds 7 distinct supplemental hydrocele examples.
sourceCoverage.coreEvidence: No auditable Core Radiology source supplied in this bundle.

sourceAttributionRules: Use clean human-facing labels such as RadPrimer image 2 and STATdx image 6 in prose.
Keep RP-02 and SDX-06 style IDs in registry, filenames, manifest, and traceability fields.

sourcePriority: STATdx supplemental depth and source-preferred duplicate image replacements

keepFromRadPrimer: RadPrimer article scaffold for definition, ultrasound anatomy, pathology, differential diagnosis, clinical course, and treatment
keepFromSTATdx: all STATdx images 1-11 as the curated primary image set, including source-preferred exact duplicate replacements for RadPrimer images 1-4

expanded image examples of minimally complex/inflammatory hydrocele, longitudinal simple hydrocele, encysted spermatic cord hydrocele, chronic hydrocele with echoes, MR severity variants, bilateral septated hydroceles, and testicular compression
STATdx captions when they add modality-specific or clinical context for selected images
downweightOrSkip: Do not use STATdx breadcrumbTrail for routing because metadata.json canonicalHierarchy is authoritative.
Do not invent Core Radiology validation because no auditable Core Radiology source is supplied.
Do not use RadPrimer images 1-4 as default downloads because they are exact duplicate 900 px counterparts of selected STATdx images 1-4.

sourceSelectionPlan.imageCurationPolicy: Exact duplicates may be archived; near duplicates and conceptual replacements remain selected as recognition reinforcement unless visually identical or unusable. Download only selectedPrimaryImageIds by default.
sourceSelectionPlan.duplicateEvidencePolicy: ExactDuplicate decisions require visual evidence from image_evidence files, same stable source image ID, image hashes, or explicit manual/source confirmation. Caption-only or topic-only similarity is marked uncertain/nearDuplicate and kept primary.

caseClusterGuardrails.rule: Same-patient, follow-up, procedure, adjacent-slice, comparison-view, and time-lapse clusters are atomic teaching clusters.
caseClusterGuardrails.note: No source case cluster was intentionally split. RadPrimer images 1-4 are archived only as whole exact-duplicate counterparts of selected STATdx images 1-4. STATdx image 4 preserves its single-image aspiration/sclerotherapy procedure context.

imageDownloadPlan.sourceQualifiedFilenamePolicy: Use the registry downloadFilenameStem/plainFilename values, preserving RP-02 and SDX-06 style IDs in filenames while using clean labels such as RadPrimer image 2 or STATdx image 6 in narrative prose.

generatorInstructions: Use clean source-qualified image labels in narrative prose, such as STATdx image 6 or RadPrimer image 2.
Keep RP-02 and SDX-06 style IDs in traceability fields, filenames, registries, and manifest metadata rather than crowding narrative prose with both labels.
Do not archive near duplicates, alternate examples, modality variants, or severity variants by default; keep them as recognition reinforcement.
Do not generate cards or lecture content from this package until a later explicit request.
